goal: Narrow the live TaskRecord union from TaskRecordV3 | TaskRecordV4 to TaskRecordV4 alone, rejecting a v3-contract record at every live reducer/coordinator entry point instead of letting it progress to completion, while extracting TaskRecordV2/TaskRecordV3 and their frozen parsers into a dedicated historical-only module that readAuditTaskPair keeps using to read existing .imm/audit/ v2 and v3 terminal records unchanged.

acceptance.assertion: A v3-contract TaskRecord fed through the live reducer (reduceTask) is rejected instead of progressing its lifecycle to done; the existing test's core assertion is rewritten to prove rejection, not deleted.

The dual-host conformance test's v3 case is rewritten (title and body) so a v3-contract record fails closed through coordinator.advance()/submitReview() for both the Claude and Pi host adapters, identically to how vFuture, stale identity, and concurrent continuation already fail closed in the same test.
readAuditTaskPair and its callers continue reading existing .imm/audit/ v2 and v3 terminal records unchanged through the relocated frozen historical reader module.

v4-only live-path reducer and risk-downgrade-guard behavior is unaffected by the narrowing, and the frozen parseTaskRecordV3/parseTaskRecordV2 parser-level tests keep passing from their new historical-only module location.
